reviews.comment: If you ask a question, he may look at you weirdly. We only had 6/35 people come to class because he does not teach in an effective way. There is so much information, I don't conceive how it is possible to get a good grade in this class. It's a difficult topic, and he does not make it any easier. Wait until another prof is teaching.

Dr. Cline has excellent notes and clearly knows the material. There are many slides, but he covers them carefully and wants students to understand. Homework can be long, but it is graded leniently. Exams closely follow the homework/slides, and he provides a very useful cheat sheet. Tough class but an 85 is an A.
This was the absolute worst professor I have ever encountered in my life. I dropped the program 100% because of him. Don't make the same mistake I did.

I graduated from high school, college, and medical school, and I have never encountered a professor who is so unbelievably awful. Seems to find more pleasure in stumping students than actually explaining anything. I dropped my masters program because of him.

Dr. Cline is the worst professor I have ever had in my entire academic career.  He clearly knows his stuff, but makes you feel so stupid when a question is asked.  Reads directly from slides, and the homework takes at least ten hours a week.  Tests are also brutal.  Do not take from this man.  Switch your major if possible.  He is truly that bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course was one of the hardest courses I have ever taken, and it was kinda fun. I recommend studying for each exam as early as possible and redoing the homework multiple times to really understand the concepts. I went into Dr. Cline's office hours a couple of times, and he really helped me understand some of the concepts I had trouble with.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. He has little to no compassion and is the most unapproachable person I have ever met.

Lectures are useless for preparing you to know how to "do" the actual homework.  Youtube will be your best teacher to find people showing you how to actually do the problems.  Makes concepts needlessly difficult - go buy a different textbook (I recommend Hogg, Tanis and Zimmerman 10th Ed.) which will massively simplify things.

I was very worried about this class after seeing the low rating, but after taking the class I actually thought it was fine. Overall, I thought class was extremely fair.

Con: Homework was very time intensive

Pros:
He posted notes for every lecture
Textbook was free
Lectures were useful
He provides practice tests, and gives lots of partial credit
It was such a weird class to take: self-study, no support. Exams are easy, but one feels stressed out the entire time.
Homework takes an unreasonable amount of time & test time is not enough to complete

This is by far the worse professor you will take, the amount of homework is excessive the tests are very difficult and are more difficult this semester then the last semester, I thought I was going to get a B until his stupid final brought me down a full letter grade, awful professor do not take

This was by far the worst class I have taken. I actually believe that Cline tried to make it as difficult as possible as some sort of trial. It would have been better to learn the material without him, and I think he would have preferred that, too. Do not even consider taking STAT 630 from him.

This class was bad. It was material I had learned in my undergrad and actually I was a TA to that class. This was required for my graduate degree and Dr. Cline made it so convoluted and difficult even when I knew a lot of it. Some topics were briefly covered and we were expected to know it on a deep level. Worst professor I have had at A&M.

He is by far the worst professor I have ever had the misfortune of taking. The only major change is that now his exams are HARDER than the homeworks (which are longgg). He is not only a terrible teacher (just reads off the slides), but also has an extremely nasty attitude. Will insult you if you ask questions. Wait a semester if he is teaching 630.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I saw the ratings before signing up for this class, and mistakenly dismissed them. Homework was easily 15+ hours a week and the textbook was littered with errata. Lectures were him reading off another profs slides, and testing required deep understanding. Asking any question risks ridicule. Worse than not having a prof at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Three words: Homeworks are ridiculous. He gives weekly homeworks that are insanely long and unreasonably complex given the content on the exams (which were easier than the homeworks). You can tell he is very smart, so a lot of the simple material in lecture is over-complicated. This class requires genuine commitment to pull off the grade you want.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The worst part of the class was the homework which is not an exaggeration when I say that each one for every single week took up at least 10 hours even with the help of graduate student help sessions (who were amazing btw). Also, there are very few test questions so you better know everything and the final is also 40% to boot, smart prof however.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Cline might seem a bit standoffish at first but he's actually quite caring. You see this in his homework assignments. The problem sets are really well curated and are more than adequate to prepare you for exams. If you put in the effort on the problem sets you basically won't have to study for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not a good professor. All he does is read off the powerpoint then leave right when class ends. He's not very nice when you ask a question in class. 414 is a very hard class and he doesn't make it easier for students. I will say that he gives fair partial credit on exams.
Hard class and he doesnt help at all. Cant teach whatsoever. Anytime you ask a question he a) doesnt answer it and b) makes you feel stupid. Good luck.
Worst professor ever. He is really bad at teaching. I did not learn anything from the lectures. His office hour is not also helpful.

Pretty darn bad at teaching. I'm expected to get an A or B in the class depending on my final, but I can honestly say everything I've learned has been self taught. I've been to every lecture, and can tell you it's worthless and most people don't show up. Doesn't help. Really long homeworks. Curves class 5 points but still doesn't help most people
